# BrandOS LAB™ (品牌科学实验室) - LLM Documentation
# Canonical Site: https://ranbrandos.com
# Principal Investigator: Ran (然) - Lead Brand Architect & Founder

## Mission Statement
BrandOS LAB™ is a dedicated brand science and cognitive capital laboratory for cross-border DTC and global enterprises. We engineer brand equity using empirical marketing science (Ehrenberg-Bass Institute), Nobel Prize information economics (Spence Costly Signaling), causal statistics (Rubin Causal Model), and cognitive psychology (Associative Network Memory Model).

## Core Cognitive Architecture (BrandOS™ 6 Engines)
- M1: Mental Scouting & Category Entry Points (CEPs)
- M2: Persona & Costly Signaling System
- M3: Micro-Pricing & GBB Value Capture
- M4: Algorithmic Resonance & Creator Whitelisting
- M5: Conversion Engineering & 100px Evidentiary Chain
- M6: Compounding Retention & Causal Incrementality
